note: Jehovih as the one who awakens/gives life; spiritual quickening sense, not literal 'speeds up'. Paired with Mover/Creator/Destroyer as divine titles.
Recurring formula asserting that existence/life flows from Jehovih's presence.

ja: 我は「最初」にして「最後」なり
note: Divine self-declaration of encompassing all time; rendered reverently, distinct from biblical Alpha/Omega phrasing.

en: I commanded man to name them
ja: 我は人に命じてこれらに名を付けしめた
note: Recurring creation-and-naming formula in this chapter; Jehovih creates, man names. Keep consistent across verses 1, 4, 8.

en: the seen and the unseen worlds
zh_hant: 可見與不可見的諸世界
zh_hans: 可见与不可见的诸世界
ja: 見ゆる世界と見えざる世界
note: Core cosmological pairing (Corpor vs Es); 'seen/unseen' rendered 可見/不可見 and 見ゆる/見えざる throughout.
Standard rendering for Jehovih's highest worlds; ties to the Etherea/Ethe entries.
'corporeal' consistently rendered 有形 / 有形の, tying man's flesh to Corpor.
The natural whirlwind used as the earthly sign/analogue of the vortex; distinct from the coined term 'vortex' (渦旋/渦). Rendered 旋風/つむじ風 throughout.
'corporeal' consistently rendered 有形 / 有形の, tying created worlds to Corpor; plural companion to the locked 'corporeal body'.
The corporeal, atmospherean and etherean estates bestowed on man; theologically loaded triad summarizing Oahspe's cosmology of man's dwelling.
The mortal, visible man of Corpor; theologically paired with 'spiritual man'. 'corporeal' consistently 有形 / 有形の, tying man to the locked 'corporeal body'.
The unseen, everlasting man within the unseen; theologically paired with 'corporeal man'. Rendered 靈性之人 / 霊なる人 to keep the elevated register.

en: I am the Unity of the whole
note: Climactic divine self-declaration: seen and unseen are all parts of Jehovih's person. Rendered reverently, paralleling the locked 'I am FIRST and LAST'.

The lowest heaven of atmospherea, nearest the earth, where spirits of the lower heaven dwell after mortal death; a recurring cosmological locus. (rendered from 'lower heaven'/'first heaven' occurrences)
The act by which Jehovih's presence animates se'mu into living beings; closely related to 'the QUICKENER' but in verbal/passive form. Theologically loaded and recurring across this chapter.

en: flesh of My flesh and spirit of My spirit
zh_hant: 我之肉中的肉，我之靈中的靈
zh_hans: 我之肉中的肉，我之灵中的灵
ja: 我が肉の肉、我が霊の霊
note: Formulaic theological declaration that all living creatures are part of Jehovih's own being; echoes scriptural register throughout Oahspe.
The moment of intellectual/spiritual awakening when man grasps the physical world and looks beyond it; marks the threshold between beast-man and spirit-seeking man.

en: his spirit had crystallized into separateness
zh_hant: 他的靈魂已結晶而成獨立之體
zh_hans: 他的灵魂已结晶而成独立之体
ja: その霊は結晶して独立の体をなした
note: Theological phrase for the soul's attainment of individual spiritual identity, capable of ascending apart from the corporeal body; loaded spiritual term in Oahspe.

en: the unreal hath become the real
ja: 不実のものは実となりぬ
note: Man's confession that the unseen spiritual realm, once dismissed, is now revealed as the only true reality; counterpart to the locked 'the seen and the unseen worlds'.

zh_hant: 在天上共同承受業業的人
zh_hans: 在天上共同承受业业的人
ja: 天において共同の相続人となるべき者たち
note: Theological phrase for the new race (man) who shares in the etherean inheritance alongside the guardian angels; marks the transition from Asu to the new joint-heir race.
Angels assigned to walk beside and watch over the new race born of the first union; a recurring divine role in Oahspe's cosmology.

zh_hant: 進入我的以太界諸世界的生來權利
zh_hans: 进入我的以太界诸世界的生来权利
ja: 我がエセ界の諸世界への生得の権利
note: The congenital spiritual inheritance granted to mankind through the quickening of the new race's seed; closely tied to 'etherean worlds' and 'quickened into life'.
Recurring designation for Asu, the purely corporeal first humanity, as distinct from the new race (man) born of angel-Asu union. Formulaic in ch. 6.
